units: <cite ref="Shabbat 67a:3">Sabb. 67ᵃ</cite> <he>לִיחֲרוֹק ביה פורתא</he> let him cut a little notch into it. Part. <he>חָרֵיק</he>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 9:3:14">Y. Kil. IX, 32ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>וח׳ בשינוי</he> and gnashing his teeth; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 12:3:14">Y. Keth. XII, 35ᵇ</cite> <he>וחרוק</he> (corr. acc.).

senses.gloss: <cite ref="H01760">same</cite>. Y. Kil. l. c. <he>הויתא א׳ בשינייך</he> thou wast gnashing thy teeth; Y. Keth. l. c. <he>הוות א׳ בשינוי</he> (corr. acc.).
